findings.evidence: Job Assignment and Salary The Employer hereby engages the Employee and the Employee agrees to work for the Employer in the position of Legal Counsel at the rate of 80,000 THB per month. The salary shall be paid on the 25 day of the month.
findings.explanation: Clause found under heading 'Job Assignment and Salary'.

findings.evidence: Working hours The working hours shall not exceed 40 hours per week.
findings.explanation: Found 40 hours; meets the requirement of at least 40 hours.

findings.evidence: Termination of the Contract In case the Employer terminates the contract, the Employer shall give one month notice to the Employee, or pay one month salary in lieu of giving notice, or otherwise act in conformity with the local labour law. In case the Employee terminates the contract, the Employee shall give one month notice to the Employer.
findings.explanation: Found 1 months; meets the requirement of at least 1 months.
